assessments.reasoning: Lines 4–7 of the FSF plaintext identify the copyright holder, the permitted acts, the beneficiaries and the verbatim-copy condition. Bytes [92,291) match the frozen range digest.

challenge.method: Compare distributing the full plaintext with distributing the same text after deleting the appendix's sample program notice. Also test whether §1 supplies permission for that deletion.
challenge.results: The full copy satisfies the opening notice. Deleting the example changes the document even though all numbered terms survive. Section 1 governs the Program's source code and supplies no permission for that edit.

limitations: The grant assessed here covers the complete, unchanged publisher plaintext. It establishes no separate authority to modify the document or use a mark.
reasoning: The opening notice grants everyone permission to copy and distribute the license document verbatim. Section 1 separately addresses copies of a covered Program's source code and requires recipients to receive the license along with the Program.
